source.title: Order of the Sinking Star
source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 9Mild Fantasy ViolenceGamesOrder of the Sinking StarVersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalMild Fantasy ViolenceLoadingFor every solution, a revelation.From legendary director Jonathan Blow (Braid, The Witness) comes Order of the Sinking Star, a massive adventure featuring more than one thousand hand-crafted puzzles designed to put your intellect to the test. You are transported to a realm of curious magic, dangerous contraptions, and vicious monsters. Explore four distinct worlds, each with its own mechanics, characters, and stories, and then watch as they all collide. As the worlds merge, and characters meet one another, puzzle systems intertwine, creating surprising new gameplay possibilities. Explore at your own pace, revisit worlds and return to challenges as you see fit. Discover unique playable characters, master evolving gameplay mechanics, and decipher the deep mysteries of a sprawling, interconnected game world. Blending exploration, storytelling, and ever-progressing mechanics, Order of the Sinking Star invites you into a mysterious, living puzzle unlike anything you've played.Master a Thousand Interwoven ChallengesEmbark on an innovative puzzle adventure with dozens of game mechanics and hundreds of hours of unique gameplay. Each puzzle builds on the last, introducing new game mechanics that reward curiosity and persistenceChoose Your Path, Roam at Your PaceExplore four expansive, mysterious game worlds, each with its own characters, rules, dangers, and secrets waiting to be uncovered. Come and go as you like, you are free to take on the puzzles you discover at your own pace.Take the Helm of Some Unlikely HeroesA queen, a thief, a warrior, a wizard, and a talking boat are just some of the heroes of this tale. Each character wields complimentary abilities and has captivating stories to tell.Decipher an Epic TaleAs playable characters begin to meet and worlds collide, the mystery untangles. Through gameplay and notes you collect you learn more about this enigmatic realm. Piece by piece and clue by clue, you’ll uncover the secrets of the Order of the Sinking Star.Software description provided by the publisher.Explore this game's official websiteRelated tagsAdventurePuzzleChoose your own pathVoiced charactersShow moreAbout this itemGame file size (estimated)18.9 GBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership. Also, if needed, please update to the latest patch before playing. Note: There are other set products which include this product. Please be aware of duplicate purchases. Your unwritten epic begins. Dragon's Dogma 2 presented players with a deep, explorable fantasy world, challenging them to choose their own experience – from the appearance of their Arisen, their vocation, their party, how to approach different situations and more. With Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen, that experience has been further enhanced through the addition of unforgettable new tales and thrilling encounters. Experience enhanced gameplay. Embark on uncharted adventures. Enticing value for myriad additions. Together with your loyal Pawns, set off on an unparalleled adventure! Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen - New Content 1. New Stories Await in a Brand-New Area Forsaken Dominion: Another Tale of Ruin Unfolds in the Snowy North Adventure forth to the long-abandoned region of Norgan and join forces with the enigmatic Eir, who seeks to unravel the secrets of the undying Fallen Dragon. Unearth and appraise forgotten relics to unlock powerful new weapons and skills that will aid you on your journey. 2. New Challenges in the Main Area Lost Rites: Prove Yourself with 12 Dungeon Challenges Rare equipment once held by past Arisens lays dormant in the depths of freshly uncovered unique dungeons. Whether you want to sharpen your skills or lay claim to legendary treasures—test your mettle against the Pathfinder's trials. 3. More Variation in the Character Creator New Hairstyles and Tattoos: Bring Your Characters to Life Craft your Arisen and Pawns with precision using the new options added to the robust Character Creator. Find the style right for you and embark on a fresh new adventure.Platform:PS5Release:10/9/2026Publisher:Capcom U.S.A., Inc.Genres:Role Playing Games, ActionOnline features require an account for PlayStation and are subject to terms of service and applicable privacy policy (playstation.com/Terms and playstation.com/legal/privacy-policy).
